programs.title: Another Mother
programs.desc: (2020) Psychological thriller with Alex McKenna. A woman gets engaged to a man with a young daughter, but their happiness is threatened by the girl's biological mother, who resorts to deadly measures.

programs.title: Stratton
programs.desc: (2017) Action thriller starring Dominic Cooper. A rogue Russian operative plots to unleash deadly biochemical weapons. Special Boat Service commando John Stratton is sent in to hunt him down.

programs.title: The Ballad of Lefty Brown
programs.desc: (2017) Action-packed western with Bill Pullman, Peter Fonda and Jim Caviezel. Loyalty and friendship are tested when an ageing gunslinger sets out to avenge his murdered friend.

programs.title: Bunraku
programs.desc: (2010) Martial arts action with Josh Hartnett and Woody Harrelson. A mysterious drifter, a bartender and a young samurai join up against a ruthless leader and deadly assassins.

programs.title: Triple Cross
programs.desc: (1967) WWII spy thriller with Christopher Plummer. Loosely based on a true story, bank robber Eddie Chapman gets entangled in spying for both sides during World War Two, becoming a triple agent.

programs.title: The Quick And The Dead
programs.desc: (1963) War drama starring Victor French and Majel Barrett. With the aid of local partisans, a group of American soldiers try to make it through enemy-occupied Italy to safety.
